In a class of 200 students, 40% are girls. Of the girls, 30% play sports, and of the boys, 50% play sports. How many students in total play sports?
solution: Girls = 80, Boys = 120. Girls playing sports = 30% of 80 = 24. Boys playing sports = 50% of 120 = 60. Total = 24+60 = 84.
